files_or_snippet: ExpEval.js (evaluateExpression: peek/get helpers, factor/term/expression recursive-descent functions)
how_adapted: Kept the recursive-descent skeleton (peek/get, term/expression loops). Replaced char-level scanning with a positional tokenizer (scientific notation, tabs), added power (^, right-assoc) and unary levels per SPEC precedence, % operator, CalcError with positions instead of NaN, division/remainder-by-zero, non-finite and trailing-token checks. Converted to ES module.
